paragraphs: The Spanish Missionary rides into battle carrying a sacred book. This mounted monk reflects the religious orders that carried their faith across distant lands.
In Age of Empires, his donkey lets him travel faster than a monk on foot, bringing support to an army on the move.
A Missionary turns enemy soldiers into allies and restores the health of friendly troops. Every successful conversion can change the balance of the battle without dealing a single blow.
Spanish Inquisition improves his conversion abilities. His shorter reach makes positioning crucial: he must get close enough to influence the fight while staying clear of enemy weapons.
